readings.numerator_definition: minutes that an ordinary or accessible route is unavailable because of commissioning
readings.denominator_definition: approved public-service minutes in the reporting period
readings.directionality: lower interruption is preferred but no target is preset
readings.privacy_aggregation: aggregate duration only; no personal trace

readings.numerator_definition: dynamic operating minutes completed inside the authorised envelope
readings.denominator_definition: dynamic operating minutes planned and approved
readings.directionality: more is not inherently better; safety and public gates dominate

readings.numerator_definition: person-hours of maintenance caused directly by commissioning
readings.denominator_definition: hours of dynamic operation with QA disposition PASS
readings.zero_denominator: report raw person-hours and rate as not_applicable
readings.directionality: lower burden is preferred only for matched scope and service quality
readings.privacy_aggregation: role-level labour totals; no worker performance ranking

readings.numerator_definition: elapsed hours from a valid complaint or discomfort report to human acknowledgement
readings.denominator_definition: count of valid complaints or discomfort reports
readings.zero_denominator: response time is not_applicable, never zero hours
readings.directionality: lower is preferred; no statutory numeric deadline is claimed
readings.privacy_aggregation: publish aggregate times and redacted categories only

readings.name_zh: 预检后换位/转介/停止决定
readings.numerator_definition: signed human dispositions of RELOCATE or REFER_SPECIALIST, plus separately signed cross-cutting STOP decisions after complete screening
readings.denominator_definition: complete screening cases with a signed human disposition or a separately signed cross-cutting STOP decision
readings.directionality: neutral; more changes are not automatically better
readings.privacy_aggregation: case counts only; suppress identifiable equipment or user details
